title: Police probe launched after man's death
article: Homicide detectives and the Calgary Police Service's professional standards section are investigating the involvement of four officers in the death of a 27-year-old man, police said yesterday.

Tamer Sayed Roha was handcuffed and subdued by officers responding to a disturbance complaint at a city motel late Wednesday night. When his violent outburst turned passive, police said, Mr. Roha was transported to hospital where he later died.
The medical examiner hasn't revealed the cause of death pending the outcome of toxicology tests.
